lead: A `Core` member accepts a `tainted` argument where its row says so; the trap is the type of the *answer*.
body: Only a `Sink` refuses one (`rule:security/unclassified-parameter-refuses-tainted`), and a contagious answer carries it into elements and union members: `Core\Str::split($t, ",")` is `array<tainted string>` and the plain type is `E0401`. `tainted ?string` does not parse and fails as `E0102: expected an expression` a line *before* the mismatch.
